answer: Put handwriting verification proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 779 fakes spends 12464 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The ripple test is the live device, the ferrous test is the locked stake, and the dawn test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
